_description: A single educational standard (CA_CCSS, CCSS, TEKS, or BEST).
description: Interpret key features of graphs and tables in terms of quantities; sketch graphs given verbal descriptions.
fullText: For a function that models a relationship between two quantities, interpret key features of graphs and tables in terms of the quantities, and sketch graphs showing key features given a verbal description of the relationship. Key features include: intercepts; intervals where the function is increasing, decreasing, positive, or negative; relative maximums and minimums; symmetries; end behavior; and periodicity. ★
